player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Rogue Nine''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Operations]] list on DeckTech in July 2001.
description: Hey look ... it's a dark side deck that wins.  Props to Alex Klammrodt for the pre-tatooine version of this.  Here's my version, post-tatooine, less tech, more beef: Endor Ops.
cards: posted: Oppressive Enforcement/There Is No Try
Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith
posted: Darth Vader, Dark Lord of the Sith
posted: Boba Fett in Slave I
posted: Something Special Planned For Them
posted: Your Insight Serves You Well
Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us
posted: Ghhhk/Those Rebel's Won't Escape Us
notes: Posted 18 July 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card (Coruscant: Docking Bay is the Special Edition site), so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted: Objective Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost, then under 'Starting(4)' Prepared Defenses, Imperial Arrest Order, Mobilization Points and There Is No Try & •Oppressive Enforcement; Endor, Endor: Bunker and Endor: Landing Platform (the Objective's sites) are posted under Locations. All count toward the 60.

Posted 'Oppressive Enforcement/There Is No Try' dested the Reflections II combo There Is No Try & •Oppressive Enforcement (an Effect in 2001); Secret Plans is an Effect in this era, counted in the 60.

Posted 'Endor', 'Endor Bunker', 'Endor Landing Platform' and 'Mon Calamari' dested their Dark pages; 'Coruscant Docking Bay' the Special Edition Dark site Coruscant: Docking Bay; 'Executor Docking Bay' Executor: Docking Bay.

Posted 'IG-88 w/gun' dested IG-88 With Riot Gun; '4-LOM w/gun' 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'Darth Maul' the Tatooine Darth Maul; 'Control/SFS' Control & Set For Stun; 'Ghhhk/Those Rebel's Won't Escape Us' Ghhhk & Those Rebels Won't Escape Us; 'Ominous Rumours' Ominous Rumors; 'Twilek Advisor' Twi'lek Advisor.
Posted 'Your Insight Serves You Well' under Effects: the only card of that name is a Light Side Death Star II Effect, so it cannot be in this Dark deck; kept as written (UNKNOWN) and counted.
Section counts as posted are off (Starships(10) lists 9, Effects(7) lists 8, Interrupts(11) lists 12), but the cards total 60 as published.
Update 1 says Executor Docking Bay replaced Coruscant Docking Bay, but both are still in the posted list; kept as posted.
